name: @droneey/constitution-workspace
description: The workspace of the Droneey Constitution: its rules and the tools that hold them.

scripts.check:secrets: betterleaks git . --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner
scripts.check:shell: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.sh' '*.bash' ':(exclude)apps/docs' ':(exclude)packages/@design/browser' ':(exclude)packages/@design/cli' ':(exclude)packages/@design/tokens' ':(exclude)packages/@mutation-check/python' ':(exclude)packages/@mutation-check/typescript' ':(exclude)packages/brand' ':(exclude)packages/constitution' ':(exclude)packages/python-check' | xargs -0 -r sh -c "for file do if [ -e \"\$file\" ]; then printf '%s\0' \"\$file\"; fi; done" sh | xargs -0 -r shellcheck
scripts.check:shell-format: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.sh' '*.bash' ':(exclude)apps/docs' ':(exclude)packages/@design/browser' ':(exclude)packages/@design/cli' ':(exclude)packages/@design/tokens' ':(exclude)packages/@mutation-check/python' ':(exclude)packages/@mutation-check/typescript' ':(exclude)packages/brand' ':(exclude)packages/constitution' ':(exclude)packages/python-check' | xargs -0 -r sh -c "for file do if [ -e \"\$file\" ]; then printf '%s\0' \"\$file\"; fi; done" sh | xargs -0 -r shfmt -d
scripts.fix:shell-format: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.sh' '*.bash' ':(exclude)apps/docs' ':(exclude)packages/@design/browser' ':(exclude)packages/@design/cli' ':(exclude)packages/@design/tokens' ':(exclude)packages/@mutation-check/python' ':(exclude)packages/@mutation-check/typescript' ':(exclude)packages/brand' ':(exclude)packages/constitution' ':(exclude)packages/python-check' | xargs -0 -r sh -c "for file do if [ -e \"\$file\" ]; then printf '%s\0' \"\$file\"; fi; done" sh | xargs -0 -r shfmt -w
